# Expres Polish

> Polish language school in Wrocław and online. Preparation for State Polish B1 and TELC examinations. Website languages: Ukrainian and Russian.

## School contacts

Telephone / WhatsApp: +48 881 576 552. Email: expres.polish@gmail.com.

Preparation enquiries are not examination registrations. The receiving institution determines which language certificate it accepts; see the TELC resource for verified distinctions and official sources.
